name: Shenzhen New Industries Biomedical Engineering Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen New Industries Biomedical Engineering Co., Ltd., engages in the research, development, production, and sale of clinical laboratory instruments and in vitro diagnostic reagents to hospitals in China and internationally. It offers immunoassay machine, biochemistry/electrolyte, integrated system, lab automation, molecular diagnostics, hemolumi and rapid test solutions. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
